name: scrutiny-fabric-tools
//biome: Pinned exactly, not ^: the D12 crypto-import ban is a biome nursery rule, and a minor bump that promotes or renames it would silently stop enforcing it. test/no-crypto.test.ts backs the ban independently.

scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm rules:check && pnpm ownership:check && pnpm knip && pnpm build && pnpm publint && pnpm api-report:check && pnpm attw && pnpm size && pnpm audit && pnpm test

//pnpm: vitest 3.2.7 resolves vite 5.4.21 transitively, which carries a high-severity server.fs.deny bypass and two path-traversal advisories; esbuild <0.25 lets any website reach the dev server. js-yaml <4.3.1 (via @changesets/cli's parse chain) has a quadratic-CPU !!omap advisory, and nanoid <3.3.17 (via vitest's vite->postcss chain) can loop indefinitely with a zero size. All are dev-only — vitest and changesets are devDependencies and the package ships only `diff` at runtime — but overriding is cheap and keeps `pnpm audit` clean so a real advisory is not lost in the noise. Drop each once its parent depends on a patched version directly. (`pnpm audit --prod` does not actually scope to production-only dependencies in this pnpm version's workspace mode — verified by comparing its output to plain `pnpm audit`, byte-identical — so these are pinned rather than relied on to be filtered out.)
